title: Matching index brackets do not establish that the observed index tuple was validated
description: The initial full ls-files snapshot and final full snapshot can both contain the same invalid staged blob. Actual cached-path/blob validation can read a temporarily restored accepted index in between. The only new check compares bracket equality, so native apply returns complete although its final observed index tuple is invalid. This is a within-observation mismatch, not a mutation after the last observation or a demand for global atomicity.
locators: campaign_owner_apply.py:966 initial full snapshot is stored, not used as validation authority
campaign_owner_apply.py:982-1032 cached-path and entry/blob validation independently rereads mutable index
campaign_owner_apply.py:1037-1040 equality compares endpoints without binding the validated middle view
required_fix_scope: Validate actual stage/path/mode/blob tuples from one captured logical index as the authority, and bind any separate cached/entry view to that same tuple; then compare final logical snapshot. A baseline tree comparison may derive the changed-path set from that captured map. Hash-addressed cat-file reads should use captured OIDs, not later index lookups. Keep literal NUL paths, stage/mode/retirement checks, before-versus-installed accepted endpoint checks, harmless stat refresh and legitimate staging between validation boundaries.
historical_contract: verify_completed remains historical content/provenance verification. Its success after a legitimate later commit is correct. The failure is live apply publishing complete for an invalid observed index, not historical verifier lack of a present-index lock.
bounded_limit: Even a corrected captured-tuple validation is a bounded observation and cannot prevent arbitrary mutations after the final read; no global OS/index lock or atomicity claim is requested.
regressions: Actual initial/final bad unrelated staged blob with good middle view must refuse.
Actual initial/final bad owner blob with good middle view must refuse.
Retain existing two late mutation refusals, stat-cache positive, all original tests and later-commit historical positive.
